task: static single-depot multi-vehicle mandatory-delivery cold-chain routing
objective: maximize total quality-adjusted delivery value minus distance and refrigeration costs in U, excluding common fixed terms
upstream_backbone: read-only MASKCO_code.models.CVRPModel, encode then timestep-conditioned masked-adjacency decode

modules.F_quality_context: derived age, quality margin, marginal monetary decay rate, time-window slack and load utilization from visible partial routes; removed nodes use singleton bounds, never full-teacher clock labels
modules.D_directed_denoising: directed retained-edge context, customer-successor supervision and query/key directed output; a combined direction module, not an isolated head-only claim

shared_neural_search: random customer masking, neural edge shortlist, exact-net-benefit regret reconstruction, accept only improved feasible full solutions

classical_adapters.ALNS: pinned official ALNS library; custom full-objective destroy/regret repair and SA acceptance, not a claimed paper replication
classical_adapters.VNS: custom relocate/swap/reverse/merge neighbourhoods scored by the full frozen objective

teacher_generation: online VNS starting from the common initializer, only declared training cases and conditions; stored route labels and source hashes
loss_comparison_limit: undirected-neighbour and directed-successor targets have different entropy; cross-variant raw cross-entropy is not a method-quality comparison
execution_scope: train/validation only; no outer-test execution before frozen analysis plan's method/checkpoint gates
current_claim: implementation candidate and functional checks only; no generalization, superiority or publication claim
